_comment: Every established connection into a port this machine listens on. Empty ports means all of them, which is the useful default. No network traffic: the numbers come from the kernel's own accounting via ss on Linux or nettop on macOS.
_ports_comment: Listening ports counted as inbound sessions; empty uses every listening port.
_history_comment: Minimum number of rate samples retained.
_windows_comment: What w cycles the chart through, in seconds; the first is what opens. history is only a floor — retention follows the longest window on its own.
